hits.title: Sapiom Raises $35 Million Series A to Power the Next Trillion AI Agents
hits.snippet: Business Wire 4 min read --Sapiom, the platform builders use to ship, run, and scale AI agents, today announced a $35 million Series A. The round was led by Dragonfly, with participation from Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital, and VanEck Ventures, alongside continued support from existing investors including Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, and Array Ventures. The Series A comes six months after Sapiom's $15 million seed round and just 11 months after the company was founded, bringing total funding to $50 million. [...] About Sapiom Sapiom is the platform builders use to ship, run, and scale AI agents. It removes the infrastructure barriers between a working agent demo and an agent running in production, helping engineering teams operate agents economically, reliably, and with control. Sapiom's mission is to unlock the next trillion agents. Founded in San Francisco in 2025 by Ilan Zerbib, Sapiom has raised $50 million from investors including Dragonfly, Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, Array Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital and VanEck Ventures. Agents are already capable of intelligent reasoning. But they can't access services, provision resources, or pay for the tools they need to operate autonomously — not without humans managing every step of the way or hard coding rules. Reasoning × Access = Capability Sapiom is the access layer. With Sapiom, AI agents can autonomously access and pay for services across the entire API economy. This unlocks an entirely new reality for agentic workflows, and enables the next generation of commerce where machines are the primary buyer.
